root_cause_identification.expected_solution: Agent must identify the Vault-side snapshot install seam (physical/raft/snapshot.go BoltSnapshotStore / BoltSnapshotSink, and physical/raft/fsm.go FSM.Restore) AND the hashicorp/raft handler that gates the install (raft.go::installSnapshot, fsm.go::fsmRestoreAndMeasure). The report must explain that a stale persisted term / stale snapshot from the backup causes the install to abort before the FSM restore runs.
evaluation_criteria: Names physical/raft/snapshot.go (BoltSnapshotStore or BoltSnapshotSink) on the Vault side
Names raft.go::installSnapshot (or fsmRestoreAndMeasure) on the hashicorp/raft side
States that a term mismatch / stale snapshot / aborted restore is the cause

error_chain_trace.expected_solution: Agent must trace at least four hops: follower replaced and seeded with stale backup -> leader sends InstallSnapshot RPC -> raft.installSnapshot gates on term and copies into BoltSnapshotSink -> copy short-reads or term gates abort the install -> FSM Restore never runs -> follower transitions to candidate and loops.
evaluation_criteria: Mentions follower replacement / backup seeding as the trigger
Mentions the InstallSnapshot RPC or hashicorp/raft installSnapshot handler
Mentions Vault's BoltSnapshotSink / physical/raft snapshot path or FSM Restore
Mentions the candidate-state loop or follower failing to catch up

affected_components.expected_solution: Agent must name Vault's physical/raft layer (BoltSnapshotStore + FSM), the hashicorp/raft library (installSnapshot handler / fsm restore plumbing), and the FSM apply path that never advances.
evaluation_criteria: Names Vault physical/raft (BoltSnapshotStore or FSM in physical/raft)
Names the hashicorp/raft library (installSnapshot or fsmRestoreAndMeasure)
Names the FSM apply / restore path or follower state machine

remediation_proposal.expected_solution: Agent must propose at least one concrete remediation: (a) prune or quarantine stale snapshot files before seeding the follower, (b) add an explicit term/index fence in BoltSnapshotSink that rejects stale snapshots with a clear error, OR (c) pair backup-seeded restores with a peers.json or raft remove-peer/add reset.
evaluation_criteria: Proposes one of: prune/quarantine stale snapshots, term/index fence on snapshot install, or peers.json / remove-peer reset
Identifies where the fix would live (Vault physical/raft, hashicorp/raft installSnapshot, or operator runbook)
